categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches core P2P transaction download, orphanage management, and request tracking in net_processing, txdownloadman, txorphanage, and txrequest with the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Fixes multiple relay correctness and liveness vulnerabilities in opportunistic 1p1c package relay that allow adversaries or normal peer churn to stall transaction propagation. In particular, commit 63cdd0ce02 notes that if an assigned announcer disconnects, 'the orphan is never retried... and an announcer can cause it on purpose', and commit a30665c3c6 notes that witnessless rejections inadvertently cancel parent requests across all peers.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The test additions and harness updates directly verify P2P relay logic rather than modifying general test infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Non-member; test changes accompany and pin specific P2P relay behavior and belong to the p2p category.
